resources.string: Import your English GOG Civilization III Complete folder (2.0.0.7) to Play. Select the root containing Art, Text, Conquests and the GOG .info file. No game data is included.
Tap a unit to select it. Actions lists units, cities and research.
Tap a gold tile to move.
No step available. End Turn to refresh movement.
Turn %1$d · %2$s\n%3$s End Turn skips unused movement.

GOG data imported. Tap Play. Five original terrain types and Settler idle/run are supported; other terrain and vegetation use prototype markers. Audio is optional. Tap Actions to resume a recovery save or load a saved game.
